dialogue.conversations.cat.village.ledge: Is somebody in the village behind with you?
dialogue.ledger.respond: Somebody owes me and hasn't paid.
dialogue.ledger.respond.urge_forgive: Some debts cost more to chase than they're worth.
dialogue.ledger.followup.mention_last_ti: We settled this once, didn't we?
dialogue.ledger.open/1: Somebody in this village owes me for a season's work, %1$s, and hasn't paid a bit of it.
dialogue.ledger.open/2: There's a debt on my book older than the harvest, and the name on it lives four doors down.
dialogue.ledger.open/3: I did the work. I've seen nothing for it, and it's been months.
dialogue.ledger.promise.open/1: You said you'd cover what I'm owed. I've not forgotten, and I don't think you have either.
dialogue.ledger.promise.open/2: There was talk of you settling it, %1$s. Where's that got to?
dialogue.ledger.promise.open/3: About what you offered - I'm not chasing you. I'm only asking.
dialogue.ledger.again.open/1: The debt business. It's still sat where we left it.
dialogue.ledger.again.open/2: You'll remember what's owed me. Nothing has moved.
dialogue.ledger.again.open/3: Same ledger, same gap in it.
dialogue.ledger.who.first/1: The one with the crooked gate. I'd rather you didn't spread it about.
dialogue.ledger.who.first/2: You'll have met them. I'll not say the name twice, so mind it.
dialogue.ledger.who.first/3: Four doors down, the house with the bad thatch. Now you know as much as I do.
dialogue.ledger.who.again/1: You know who. I told you already.
dialogue.ledger.who.again/2: Same name as before. It hasn't changed hands.
dialogue.ledger.who.again/3: The same house. Asking twice doesn't make it a different one.
dialogue.ledger.forgive.agrees/1: You may be right. Chasing it has cost me sleep worth more than the sum.
dialogue.ledger.forgive.agrees/2: Aye. I'll strike it off and be lighter for it.
dialogue.ledger.forgive.agrees/3: Then it's struck. I'd rather keep the neighbour than the coin.
dialogue.ledger.forgive.resents/1: You're asking me to eat the loss. Fine. It's eaten. Don't expect me to be glad.
dialogue.ledger.forgive.resents/2: Struck off, then. And I'll remember who talked me into it.
dialogue.ledger.forgive.resents/3: Right. Gone. A season's work waved at like it was nothing.
dialogue.ledger.collect.agrees/1: Plainly. Aye. I'll knock tomorrow and say the number out loud.
dialogue.ledger.collect.agrees/2: You're right that hinting hasn't worked. I'll go and ask.
dialogue.ledger.collect.agrees/3: Then I'll ask. If they say no, at least I'll know.
dialogue.ledger.cover.accepted/1: You'd do that? Then I'll take it, and I'll not pretend I'm above taking it.
dialogue.ledger.cover.accepted/2: That's a lot to offer a neighbour. I'll hold you to it and thank you after.
dialogue.ledger.cover.accepted/3: Aye, that would settle it. Bring it when you can, %1$s.
dialogue.ledger.parting.respond/1: It is. I shouldn't have burdened you with it.
dialogue.ledger.parting.respond/2: Fair. It's my book, not yours.
dialogue.ledger.settled.forgive/1: Lighter, if I'm honest. I'd not have got there on my own.
dialogue.ledger.settled.forgive/2: Struck off and stayed struck. They nod at me again, which is something.
dialogue.ledger.settled.forgive/3: Quieter. I stopped counting it, and the counting was the worst part.
dialogue.ledger.settled.collect/1: I asked. They looked at their boots and said next month.
dialogue.ledger.settled.collect/2: Better than I feared. Saying the number out loud did most of the work.
dialogue.ledger.settled.collect/3: Asked and answered. Half now, half when the lambs sell.
dialogue.ledger.settled.none/1: It hasn't. I've done nothing about it, which is its own kind of doing.
dialogue.ledger.settled.none/2: Where it was. I keep meaning to decide, and then the day goes.
dialogue.ledger.settled.none/3: Undecided. Don't look at me like that.
dialogue.ledger.remind.cover/1: There is. You said you'd settle what I'm owed, and it isn't settled.
dialogue.ledger.remind.cover/2: Aye - yours. I'm not counting the days, but I know the number.
dialogue.ledger.remind.cover/3: Only what you offered. I'd not have raised it if you hadn't asked.
dialogue.ledger.remind.speak/1: Only mine. I said I'd go and speak to them, and I will. Consider it said.
dialogue.ledger.remind.speak/2: Just the one I made myself. Leave that with me.
dialogue.ledger.remind.speak/3: Mine, not yours. I'll knock when I've the stomach for it.
dialogue.ledger.remind.nothing/1: Nothing outstanding. Nobody owes anybody a word.
dialogue.ledger.remind.nothing/2: No. We're square, you and I.
dialogue.ledger.remind.nothing/3: Not a thing. It's a strange sort of relief.
dialogue.ledger.recall.covered/1: We did. You put it right, and I've not forgotten which of us did that.
dialogue.ledger.recall.covered/2: Aye. You covered it and the book's been quiet since.
dialogue.ledger.recall.covered/3: Once, and properly. I don't need to go over it again.
dialogue.ledger.recall.nothing/1: Not what I'd call settled. We talked. That's different.
dialogue.ledger.recall.nothing/2: Did we? I've a memory of talking and none of deciding.
dialogue.ledger.parting.followup/1: Go on. Thanks for hearing it.
dialogue.ledger.parting.followup/2: Right. I've the evening's work yet.
